records.title: FAO trains extension agents for climate-smart soybean demonstration farms in northern Ghana
records.summary: FAO trained 50 agricultural extension agents to support climate-smart soybean production through demonstration farms and farmer capacity building in northern Ghana.

fr.title: La FAO forme des agents de vulgarisation pour des fermes de démonstration de soja climato-intelligent dans le nord du Ghana
fr.summary: La FAO a formé 50 agents de vulgarisation agricole afin de soutenir la production de soja adaptée au climat grâce à des fermes de démonstration et au renforcement des capacités des agriculteurs dans le nord du Ghana.

ar.title: الفاو تدرب مرشدي الزراعة لدعم مزارع تجريبية لفول الصويا الذكي مناخياً في شمال غانا
ar.summary: درّبت الفاو 50 من مرشدي الإرشاد الزراعي لدعم إنتاج فول الصويا الذكي مناخياً من خلال المزارع التجريبية وبناء قدرات المزارعين في شمال غانا.

pt.title: FAO forma agentes de extensão para explorações demonstrativas de soja climaticamente inteligente no norte do Gana
pt.summary: A FAO formou 50 agentes de extensão agrícola para apoiar a produção de soja adaptada ao clima por meio de explorações demonstrativas e capacitação de agricultores no norte do Gana.

sw.title: FAO yafunza maafisa ugani kuhusu mashamba ya maonesho ya soya yanayozingatia tabianchi kaskazini mwa Ghana
sw.summary: FAO iliwafunza maafisa ugani wa kilimo 50 kusaidia uzalishaji wa soya unaozingatia tabianchi kupitia mashamba ya maonesho na kujenga uwezo wa wakulima kaskazini mwa Ghana.

records.title: Ghana farmers strengthen soil health and soil-carbon management
records.summary: FAO and Ghana's CSIR-Soil Research Institute are supporting farmers in Upper West Region with soil assessment and sustainable soil management under the RECSOIL Ghana pilot.

records.title: EU-FAO supports Feed Ghana Programme with 150,000 poultry birds
records.summary: FAO and the EU provided poultry birds, feed and training to farmers in northern Ghana to strengthen domestic production and rural livelihoods.

records.title: Ghana strengthens agricultural data through Earth Observation and farmer registries
records.summary: A regional ESTELLA training in Accra is strengthening use of Earth Observation and farmer registries for crop monitoring, agricultural statistics and early warning.

records.title: Ghana launches Cocoa Monitor coordination platform
records.summary: The Ghana Cocoa Monitor established a steering committee to strengthen data sharing, transparency and coordination across the cocoa value chain.

records.title: Ghana advances action to reduce antibiotic use in poultry and aquaculture
records.summary: Stakeholders developed a national roadmap under RENOFARM to improve disease prevention, veterinary services and responsible antimicrobial use.

records.title: Nigeria advances agrifood systems and climate-action convergence
records.summary: Government and development partners renewed efforts to align food-systems transformation with climate action and resilience investments.

records.title: FAO reports support for more than 200,000 vulnerable people with farming inputs in northeast Nigeria
records.summary: FAO and partners are supporting vulnerable farming households with agricultural inputs to restore food production and livelihoods during the rainy season.

records.title: Nigeria advances national food and nutrition crisis preparedness plans
records.summary: Nigeria is developing a digital coordination platform to centralize agricultural and nutrition data for food-security emergency planning and response.

records.title: Nigeria faces severe food-security pressures in northeast amid disrupted agricultural livelihoods
records.summary: FAO reports that conflict, economic pressures and climate risks are disrupting agricultural livelihoods, markets and food access in northeast Nigeria.

records.title: Malawi launches STOSAR II to strengthen agricultural systems
records.summary: Malawi, FAO, SADC and the EU launched the second phase of STOSAR II to strengthen agricultural information, animal health, pest surveillance and export readiness.

fr.title: Le Malawi lance STOSAR II pour renforcer les systèmes agricoles
fr.summary: Le Malawi, la FAO, la SADC et l’Union européenne ont lancé la deuxième phase de STOSAR II afin de renforcer l’information agricole, la santé animale, la surveillance des ravageurs et la capacité d’exportation.

ar.title: ملاوي تطلق المرحلة الثانية من STOSAR لتعزيز النظم الزراعية
ar.summary: أطلقت ملاوي والفاو ومجموعة تنمية الجنوب الأفريقي والاتحاد الأوروبي المرحلة الثانية من STOSAR II لتعزيز المعلومات الزراعية وصحة الحيوان ومراقبة الآفات والجاهزية للتصدير.

pt.title: Maláui lança STOSAR II para reforçar os sistemas agrícolas
pt.summary: Maláui, a FAO, a SADC e a União Europeia lançaram a segunda fase do STOSAR II para reforçar a informação agrícola, a saúde animal, a vigilância de pragas e a preparação para exportação.

sw.title: Malawi yazindua STOSAR II kuimarisha mifumo ya kilimo
sw.summary: Malawi, FAO, SADC na Umoja wa Ulaya zilizindua awamu ya pili ya STOSAR II ili kuimarisha taarifa za kilimo, afya ya wanyama, ufuatiliaji wa wadudu waharibifu na maandalizi ya mauzo ya nje.

records.title: Climate-smart agriculture helps vulnerable communities build resilience in Malawi
records.summary: Communities in Chikwawa are using climate-smart agriculture approaches to cope with droughts, floods and erratic rainfall affecting farm livelihoods.

records.title: Malawi strengthens plant-health systems through digital innovation
records.summary: Malawi is strengthening plant-health capacity through digital approaches under the Africa Phytosanitary Programme to protect crops and agricultural trade.

records.title: Tanzania agrees on action plan to strengthen avocado value chain
records.summary: Government, researchers, farmers and private-sector actors agreed practical measures covering planting material, orchard management, post-harvest handling and markets for Tanzania's avocado sector.

fr.title: La Tanzanie adopte un plan d’action pour renforcer la filière avocat
fr.summary: Le ministère tanzanien de l’Agriculture et la FAO ont réuni les parties prenantes à Njombe pour convenir d’actions pratiques sur le matériel végétal, la gestion des vergers, la récolte, la manutention après récolte et l’accès aux marchés afin d’accroître les revenus et les exportations d’avocats.

ar.title: تنزانيا تتفق على خطة عمل لتعزيز سلسلة قيمة الأفوكادو
ar.summary: جمعت وزارة الزراعة التنزانية والفاو أصحاب المصلحة في نْجومبي للاتفاق على إجراءات عملية بشأن مواد الزراعة وإدارة البساتين والحصاد والتعامل بعد الحصاد والوصول إلى الأسواق لزيادة الدخل وصادرات الأفوكادو.

pt.title: Tanzânia aprova plano de ação para reforçar a cadeia de valor do abacate
pt.summary: O Ministério da Agricultura da Tanzânia e a FAO reuniram intervenientes em Njombe para acordar ações práticas sobre material de plantação, gestão dos pomares, colheita, manuseamento pós-colheita e acesso aos mercados, visando aumentar rendimentos e exportações de abacate.

sw.title: Tanzania yakubaliana mpango wa hatua wa kuimarisha mnyororo wa thamani wa parachichi
sw.summary: Wizara ya Kilimo ya Tanzania na FAO ziliwakutanisha wadau mjini Njombe kukubaliana hatua za vitendo kuhusu miche, usimamizi wa bustani, uvunaji, utunzaji baada ya mavuno na masoko ili kuongeza mapato na mauzo ya nje ya parachichi.

records.title: Guinea supports restoration of degraded landscapes through assisted natural regeneration
records.summary: FAO launched training in Mamou to promote assisted natural regeneration, restore degraded land and strengthen community resilience to climate change.

records.title: Guinea uses sustainable energy to modernize agricultural infrastructure
records.summary: FAO supported photovoltaic systems at seed centres in Kilissi and Koba to improve energy resilience and strengthen agricultural infrastructure.

records.title: Lesotho strengthens capacity for sustainable potato value-chain development
records.summary: Lesotho is strengthening national capacity for potato value-chain development as the crop gains importance for food security and rural incomes.

records.title: FAO launches youth-led vegetable project in Lesotho
records.summary: A two-year youth-focused initiative aims to support Lesotho's fresh vegetable sector through training, enterprise development and market opportunities.

records.title: Potato value-chain development expands rural opportunities in Lesotho
records.summary: The potato sector is being strengthened through improved inputs, technical support, local seed development and stronger market opportunities.

records.title: Foot-and-mouth disease escalates across Southern Africa
records.summary: FAO reports an intensifying regional foot-and-mouth disease crisis affecting livestock production and trade, with major implications for Southern African farming communities.

records.title: Zimbabwe takes agrifood investment opportunities to FAO Hand-in-Hand Forum
records.summary: Zimbabwe is presenting a USD 1.65 billion agrifood investment portfolio covering maize, soyabean, blueberries, dairy and integrated water infrastructure.
records.review_reason: Same Zimbabwe USD 1.65 billion Hand-in-Hand portfolio announcement is already covered by the direct FAO Zimbabwe country article; keep the country article as canonical and avoid a duplicate card.

records.title: Southern, Central and Eastern African countries strengthen coordinated PPR action
records.summary: A regional workshop in Dar es Salaam agreed measures for cross-border surveillance, preparedness, information sharing and control of Peste des Petits Ruminants affecting sheep and goats.

fr.title: Les pays d’Afrique australe, centrale et orientale renforcent l’action coordonnée contre la PPR
fr.summary: Un atelier régional à Dar es Salaam a convenu de mesures de surveillance transfrontalière, de préparation, de partage d’informations et de lutte contre la peste des petits ruminants qui touche les moutons et les chèvres.

ar.title: دول جنوب ووسط وشرق أفريقيا تعزز العمل المنسق لمكافحة طاعون المجترات الصغيرة
ar.summary: اتفقت ورشة إقليمية في دار السلام على تدابير للرصد عبر الحدود والاستعداد وتبادل المعلومات ومكافحة طاعون المجترات الصغيرة الذي يصيب الأغنام والماعز.

pt.title: Países da África Austral, Central e Oriental reforçam a ação coordenada contra a PPR
pt.summary: Um workshop regional em Dar es Salaam acordou medidas de vigilância transfronteiriça, preparação, partilha de informação e controlo da peste dos pequenos ruminantes, que afeta ovinos e caprinos.

sw.title: Nchi za Kusini, Kati na Mashariki mwa Afrika zaimarisha hatua za pamoja dhidi ya PPR
sw.summary: Warsha ya kikanda mjini Dar es Salaam ilikubaliana hatua za ufuatiliaji wa mipakani, maandalizi, kubadilishana taarifa na kudhibiti ugonjwa wa PPR unaoathiri kondoo na mbuzi.

records.title: FAO expands livelihood and One Health support in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo
records.summary: FAO is supporting communities affected by Ebola in Ituri and North Kivu with veterinary capacity, seeds, tools, poultry and cash assistance.

fr.title: La FAO renforce l’aide aux moyens de subsistance et l’approche « Une seule santé » dans l’est de la RDC
fr.summary: La FAO soutient les communautés touchées par Ebola en Ituri et au Nord-Kivu grâce au renforcement des services vétérinaires, à la distribution de semences et d’outils, à l’appui à l’aviculture et à une aide en espèces pour protéger les moyens de subsistance et la sécurité alimentaire.

ar.title: الفاو توسع دعم سبل العيش ونهج الصحة الواحدة في شرق جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية
ar.summary: تدعم الفاو المجتمعات المتضررة من إيبولا في إيتوري وشمال كيفو من خلال تعزيز الخدمات البيطرية وتوفير البذور والأدوات ودعم تربية الدواجن والمساعدات النقدية لحماية سبل العيش والأمن الغذائي.

pt.title: FAO amplia o apoio aos meios de subsistência e à abordagem Uma Só Saúde no leste da RDC
pt.summary: A FAO apoia comunidades afetadas pelo Ébola em Ituri e Kivu do Norte através do reforço dos serviços veterinários, distribuição de sementes e ferramentas, apoio à avicultura e assistência monetária para proteger os meios de subsistência e a segurança alimentar.

sw.title: FAO yaongeza msaada wa maisha na mkabala wa Afya Moja mashariki mwa DRC
sw.summary: FAO inasaidia jamii zilizoathiriwa na Ebola Ituri na Kivu Kaskazini kwa kuimarisha huduma za mifugo, kusambaza mbegu na zana, kusaidia ufugaji wa kuku na kutoa msaada wa fedha ili kulinda maisha na usalama wa chakula.

records.title: FAO strengthens early action ahead of drier Southern African season
records.summary: The Southern African Regional Climate Outlook Forum indicates below-normal rainfall across much of the region, prompting work on early agricultural action covering seed, feed, water and financing.

records.title: Zambia joins regional action to strengthen PPR surveillance and preparedness
records.summary: Zambia participated in the regional PPR workshop that agreed coordinated surveillance and preparedness measures and highlighted pathways toward maintaining PPR-free status.

fr.title: La Zambie participe à l’action régionale pour renforcer la surveillance et la préparation contre la PPR
fr.summary: La Zambie a participé à l’atelier régional sur la PPR, qui a convenu de mesures coordonnées de surveillance et de préparation et a souligné les moyens de préserver le statut indemne de la maladie.

ar.title: زامبيا تنضم إلى الجهود الإقليمية لتعزيز رصد طاعون المجترات الصغيرة والاستعداد له
ar.summary: شاركت زامبيا في ورشة إقليمية بشأن طاعون المجترات الصغيرة اتفقت على تدابير منسقة للرصد والاستعداد وسلطت الضوء على سبل الحفاظ على وضع خلو البلاد من المرض.

pt.title: Zâmbia participa na ação regional para reforçar a vigilância e a preparação contra a PPR
pt.summary: A Zâmbia participou no workshop regional sobre a PPR, que acordou medidas coordenadas de vigilância e preparação e destacou formas de manter o estatuto livre da doença.

sw.title: Zambia yashiriki hatua za kikanda kuimarisha ufuatiliaji na maandalizi dhidi ya PPR
sw.summary: Zambia ilishiriki warsha ya kikanda kuhusu PPR iliyokubaliana hatua za pamoja za ufuatiliaji na maandalizi na kusisitiza njia za kudumisha hali ya kutokuwa na ugonjwa huo.

records.title: West Africa strengthens climate and environment cooperation for agrifood resilience
records.summary: FAO's West Africa Climate and Environment mechanism met in Dakar to strengthen support for countries and advance climate-resilient agrifood systems.

fr.title: La FAO renforce le mécanisme climat et environnement en Afrique de l’Ouest pour mieux soutenir les pays
fr.summary: Le mécanisme Climat et Environnement de la FAO pour l’Afrique de l’Ouest s’est réuni à Dakar afin de renforcer l’appui aux pays et de faire progresser des systèmes agroalimentaires résilients au climat.

ar.title: الفاو تعزز آلية المناخ والبيئة في غرب أفريقيا لتحسين دعم البلدان
ar.summary: اجتمعت آلية المناخ والبيئة التابعة للفاو في غرب أفريقيا في داكار لتعزيز الدعم المقدم للبلدان ودفع نظم زراعية وغذائية قادرة على الصمود أمام تغير المناخ.

pt.title: FAO reforça o mecanismo de clima e ambiente na África Ocidental para apoiar melhor os países
pt.summary: O mecanismo de Clima e Ambiente da FAO para a África Ocidental reuniu-se em Dakar para reforçar o apoio aos países e promover sistemas agroalimentares resilientes às alterações climáticas.

sw.title: FAO yaimarisha mfumo wa tabianchi na mazingira Afrika Magharibi ili kusaidia nchi vyema
sw.summary: Mfumo wa Tabianchi na Mazingira wa FAO kwa Afrika Magharibi ulikutana Dakar kuimarisha msaada kwa nchi na kuendeleza mifumo ya kilimo na chakula inayostahimili mabadiliko ya tabianchi.

records.title: Somalia highlights early-warning systems as a foundation for agricultural resilience
records.summary: FAO highlights Somalia's experience using food-security assessments, data systems and early warning mechanisms to strengthen timely resilience action.

records.title: Liberia agriculture ministry seeks US$69 million in 2027 budget to strengthen farmer support
records.summary: Liberia's Ministry of Agriculture is seeking increased 2027 budget support for farmer assistance and food production.
records.review_reason: Generic ministry news listing rather than a direct article; replace with a specific article URL.

records.title: FAO-supported borehole improves water access for farmers in The Gambia
records.summary: A borehole supported by FAO is improving water access and reducing pressure around agricultural and community water needs in Ngunta.

records.title: FAO highlights fonio as an opportunity for nutrition, resilience and rural livelihoods in Ghana
records.summary: FAO highlighted fonio from northern Ghana as an ancient grain with potential to support nutrition, climate resilience and women producers' livelihoods.

records.title: FAO launches tools to help governments track agrifood public spending in Africa
records.summary: FAO launched tools designed to help governments track and allocate public spending across agrifood systems, with the launch taking place in Kigali.

records.title: FAO warns that hunger and malnutrition crises persist in Somalia amid flood and funding risks
records.summary: FAO reports continuing hunger and malnutrition pressures in Somalia, with projected flooding and funding shortfalls threatening vulnerable populations.

fr.title: La FAO alerte sur la persistance de la faim et de la malnutrition en Somalie face aux risques d’inondation et au manque de financement
fr.summary: La FAO fait état de pressions persistantes liées à la faim et à la malnutrition en Somalie, alors que les risques d’inondation prévus et les déficits de financement menacent les populations vulnérables.

ar.title: الفاو تحذر من استمرار الجوع وسوء التغذية في الصومال وسط مخاطر الفيضانات ونقص التمويل
ar.summary: تفيد الفاو باستمرار ضغوط الجوع وسوء التغذية في الصومال، في حين تهدد الفيضانات المتوقعة ونقص التمويل السكان الأكثر ضعفاً.

pt.title: FAO alerta que a fome e a desnutrição persistem na Somália em meio a riscos de cheias e falta de financiamento
pt.summary: A FAO relata que a fome e a desnutrição continuam a pressionar a Somália, enquanto as cheias previstas e as lacunas de financiamento ameaçam as populações vulneráveis.

sw.title: FAO yaonya kuwa njaa na utapiamlo vinaendelea Somalia huku kukiwa na hatari za mafuriko na upungufu wa ufadhili
sw.summary: FAO inaripoti kuwa changamoto za njaa na utapiamlo zinaendelea Somalia, huku mafuriko yanayotarajiwa na mapungufu ya ufadhili yakitishia watu walio katika mazingira hatarishi.

records.title: Togo’s SIHAM agricultural information platform moves into long-term operation
records.summary: The Food Systems Resilience Programme transferred the hydro-agrometeorological information platform and five digital kiosks to national farmer and institutional partners; services include weather, market, input, insurance and credit information.
records.source: Togo Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, Animal Resources and Food Sovereignty

fr.title: La plateforme d’information agricole SIHAM du Togo passe à une exploitation durable à long terme
fr.summary: Le Programme de résilience des systèmes alimentaires a transféré la plateforme hydro-agrométéorologique et cinq kiosques numériques aux partenaires nationaux agricoles et institutionnels. Les services fournissent des informations sur la météo, les marchés, les intrants, l’assurance et le crédit.

ar.title: منصة SIHAM للمعلومات الزراعية في توغو تنتقل إلى التشغيل المستدام طويل الأجل
ar.summary: نقل برنامج مرونة النظم الغذائية المنصة الهيدرومناخية الزراعية وخمسة أكشاك رقمية إلى الشركاء الزراعيين والمؤسسات الوطنية. وتوفر الخدمات معلومات عن الطقس والأسواق والمدخلات والتأمين والائتمان.

pt.title: A plataforma de informação agrícola SIHAM do Togo passa a uma operação sustentável de longo prazo
pt.summary: O Programa de Resiliência dos Sistemas Alimentares transferiu a plataforma hidroagrometeorológica e cinco quiosques digitais para parceiros agrícolas e institucionais nacionais. Os serviços fornecem informações sobre meteorologia, mercados, insumos, seguros e crédito.

sw.title: Jukwaa la taarifa za kilimo la SIHAM nchini Togo laingia katika uendeshaji endelevu wa muda mrefu
sw.summary: Mpango wa Ustahimilivu wa Mifumo ya Chakula ulihamisha jukwaa la taarifa za hali ya hewa na maji kwa kilimo pamoja na vibanda vitano vya kidijitali kwa washirika wa kitaifa wa kilimo na taasisi. Huduma zake hutoa taarifa kuhusu hali ya hewa, masoko, pembejeo, bima na mikopo.

records.title: Seychelles ministry reviews tuna processing and value addition
records.summary: The fisheries and agriculture minister visited Indian Ocean Tuna Limited to review processing capacity, export operations, employment, sustainability and use of fish by-products across the tuna value chain.
records.source: Seychelles Ministry of Fisheries, Agriculture and Blue Economy

fr.title: Le ministère des Seychelles examine la transformation du thon et la création de valeur
fr.summary: Le ministre chargé de la pêche et de l’agriculture a visité Indian Ocean Tuna Limited afin d’examiner les capacités de transformation, les exportations, l’emploi, la durabilité et la valorisation des sous-produits tout au long de la chaîne du thon.

ar.title: وزارة سيشل تراجع تصنيع التونة وإضافة القيمة
ar.summary: زار وزير الثروة السمكية والزراعة شركة Indian Ocean Tuna Limited لمراجعة قدرات التصنيع وعمليات التصدير والتوظيف والاستدامة والاستفادة من المنتجات الثانوية عبر سلسلة قيمة التونة.

pt.title: Ministério das Seychelles analisa o processamento do atum e a criação de valor
pt.summary: O ministro responsável pelas pescas e agricultura visitou a Indian Ocean Tuna Limited para analisar a capacidade de processamento, as exportações, o emprego, a sustentabilidade e a utilização de subprodutos ao longo da cadeia de valor do atum.

sw.title: Wizara ya Shelisheli yakagua uchakataji wa tuna na uongezaji thamani
sw.summary: Waziri wa uvuvi na kilimo alitembelea Indian Ocean Tuna Limited kukagua uwezo wa uchakataji, shughuli za mauzo ya nje, ajira, uendelevu na matumizi ya bidhaa za ziada katika mnyororo wa thamani wa tuna.

records.title: Seychelles and EU launch the 2026–2030 fisheries partnership protocol
records.summary: Seychelles and the European Union launched operations under their new sustainable fisheries partnership protocol and approved sectoral support priorities, including artisanal fishing communities, aquaculture development, research and monitoring.
records.source: Seychelles Ministry of Fisheries, Agriculture and Blue Economy

fr.title: Les Seychelles et l’Union européenne lancent le protocole de partenariat halieutique 2026–2030
fr.summary: Les Seychelles et l’Union européenne ont lancé la mise en œuvre de leur nouveau protocole de partenariat pour une pêche durable et approuvé des priorités d’appui sectoriel, notamment pour la pêche artisanale, l’aquaculture, la recherche et le suivi.

ar.title: سيشل والاتحاد الأوروبي يطلقان بروتوكول الشراكة في مصايد الأسماك للفترة 2026–2030
ar.summary: أطلقت سيشل والاتحاد الأوروبي تنفيذ بروتوكول الشراكة الجديد للصيد المستدام، ووافقا على أولويات الدعم القطاعي، بما فيها مجتمعات الصيادين الحرفيين وتطوير الاستزراع المائي والبحث والرصد.

pt.title: Seychelles e União Europeia lançam protocolo de parceria das pescas para 2026–2030
pt.summary: Seychelles e União Europeia iniciaram a execução do novo protocolo de parceria para pescas sustentáveis e aprovaram prioridades de apoio ao setor, incluindo comunidades de pesca artesanal, desenvolvimento da aquicultura, investigação e monitorização.

sw.title: Shelisheli na Umoja wa Ulaya wazindua itifaki ya ushirikiano wa uvuvi wa 2026–2030
sw.summary: Shelisheli na Umoja wa Ulaya walianza kutekeleza itifaki mpya ya ushirikiano wa uvuvi endelevu na kuidhinisha vipaumbele vya msaada wa sekta, ikiwemo jamii za wavuvi wadogo, maendeleo ya ufugaji wa samaki, utafiti na ufuatiliaji.

records.title: Seychelles explores marine science and seafood-processing cooperation with China
records.summary: A Seychelles delegation took part in the 2026 Global Ocean Development Forum and visited marine science and seafood-processing institutions while exploring cooperation on sustainable marine industries and resource management.
records.source: Seychelles Ministry of Fisheries, Agriculture and Blue Economy

fr.title: Les Seychelles explorent avec la Chine une coopération en sciences marines et en transformation des produits de la mer
fr.summary: Une délégation des Seychelles a participé au Forum mondial sur le développement des océans 2026 et visité des institutions de sciences marines et de transformation des produits de la mer afin d’explorer des possibilités de coopération sur les industries marines durables et la gestion des ressources.

ar.title: سيشل تبحث مع الصين فرص التعاون في علوم البحار وتصنيع المنتجات البحرية
ar.summary: شارك وفد من سيشل في المنتدى العالمي لتنمية المحيطات لعام 2026 وزار مؤسسات لعلوم البحار وتصنيع المأكولات البحرية لاستكشاف فرص التعاون في الصناعات البحرية المستدامة وإدارة الموارد.

pt.title: Seychelles explora com a China oportunidades de cooperação em ciência marinha e processamento de produtos do mar
pt.summary: Uma delegação das Seychelles participou no Fórum Global de Desenvolvimento dos Oceanos de 2026 e visitou instituições de ciência marinha e processamento de produtos do mar para explorar cooperação em indústrias marinhas sustentáveis e gestão de recursos.

sw.title: Shelisheli yazichunguza fursa za ushirikiano na China katika sayansi ya bahari na uchakataji wa mazao ya baharini
sw.summary: Ujumbe wa Shelisheli ulishiriki katika Jukwaa la Kimataifa la Maendeleo ya Bahari la 2026 na kutembelea taasisi za sayansi ya bahari na uchakataji wa mazao ya baharini kuchunguza ushirikiano katika viwanda endelevu vya baharini na usimamizi wa rasilimali.

records.title: Chad strengthens local flour value chains through a new food-processing study
records.summary: FAO, Chad’s Ministry of Agricultural Production and Industrialization, the World Food Programme and the European Union brought together public institutions, producers, processors and partners to validate a study of fortified and unfortified flour value chains. The work is intended to guide action on local processing, market competitiveness and nutrition-sensitive food systems.

fr.title: Le Tchad renforce les chaînes de valeur locales de la farine grâce à une nouvelle étude sur la transformation alimentaire
fr.summary: La FAO, le ministère tchadien de la Production agricole et de l’Industrialisation, le Programme alimentaire mondial et l’Union européenne ont réuni institutions publiques, producteurs et transformateurs pour valider une étude sur les chaînes de valeur des farines enrichies et non enrichies. Le travail doit guider les actions sur la transformation locale, la compétitivité des marchés et les systèmes alimentaires sensibles à la nutrition.

ar.title: تشاد تعزز سلاسل قيمة الدقيق المحلي عبر دراسة جديدة لتصنيع الأغذية
ar.summary: جمعت الفاو ووزارة الإنتاج الزراعي والتصنيع في تشاد وبرنامج الأغذية العالمي والاتحاد الأوروبي المؤسسات العامة والمنتجين والمصنّعين للتحقق من دراسة حول سلاسل قيمة الدقيق المدعم وغير المدعم. وتهدف الدراسة إلى توجيه العمل في مجال التصنيع المحلي وتنافسية الأسواق والنظم الغذائية المراعية للتغذية.

pt.title: Chade reforça as cadeias de valor locais da farinha através de um novo estudo sobre transformação alimentar
pt.summary: A FAO, o Ministério da Produção Agrícola e Industrialização do Chade, o Programa Alimentar Mundial e a União Europeia reuniram instituições públicas, produtores e transformadores para validar um estudo sobre cadeias de valor de farinhas fortificadas e não fortificadas. O trabalho deverá orientar ações de processamento local, competitividade dos mercados e sistemas alimentares sensíveis à nutrição.

sw.title: Chad yaimarisha minyororo ya thamani ya unga wa ndani kupitia utafiti mpya wa uchakataji wa chakula
sw.summary: FAO, Wizara ya Uzalishaji wa Kilimo na Ustawishaji wa Viwanda ya Chad, Mpango wa Chakula Duniani na Umoja wa Ulaya ziliwakutanisha taasisi za umma, wazalishaji na wachakataji kuthibitisha utafiti kuhusu minyororo ya thamani ya unga ulioboreshwa na usioboreshwa. Kazi hiyo inalenga kuongoza uchakataji wa ndani, ushindani wa masoko na mifumo ya chakula inayozingatia lishe.

records.title: Tunisia’s FAO-backed ASCO project brings exporters into phytosanitary system modernization
records.summary: Under the EU-funded ASCO project, FAO and Tunisia’s plant-health authorities consulted more than 30 agricultural production units involved in exports. Discussions covered digital phytosanitary information and integrated pest management, aiming to reduce non-compliance risks and help producers meet export-market requirements.

fr.title: Le projet ASCO de la FAO place les producteurs et exportateurs au cœur de la modernisation du système phytosanitaire tunisien
fr.summary: Dans le cadre du projet ASCO financé par l’Union européenne, la FAO et les autorités tunisiennes de santé végétale ont consulté plus de 30 unités de production agricole exportatrices. Les échanges ont porté sur l’information phytosanitaire numérique et la lutte intégrée contre les ravageurs afin de réduire les risques de non-conformité et d’aider les producteurs à satisfaire aux exigences des marchés d’exportation.

ar.title: مشروع ASCO المدعوم من الفاو يضع المنتجين والمصدرين في صميم تحديث النظام الصحي النباتي في تونس
ar.summary: في إطار مشروع ASCO الممول من الاتحاد الأوروبي، تشاورت الفاو والسلطات التونسية للصحة النباتية مع أكثر من 30 وحدة إنتاج زراعي موجهة للتصدير. وركزت المناقشات على المعلومات الصحية النباتية الرقمية والإدارة المتكاملة للآفات لتقليل مخاطر عدم الامتثال ومساعدة المنتجين على تلبية متطلبات أسواق التصدير.

pt.title: Projeto ASCO apoiado pela FAO coloca produtores e exportadores no centro da modernização do sistema fitossanitário tunisino
pt.summary: No âmbito do projeto ASCO financiado pela União Europeia, a FAO e as autoridades fitossanitárias tunisinas consultaram mais de 30 unidades de produção agrícola ligadas à exportação. As discussões abordaram informação fitossanitária digital e gestão integrada de pragas, visando reduzir riscos de incumprimento e ajudar os produtores a cumprir os requisitos dos mercados de exportação.

sw.title: Mradi wa ASCO unaoungwa mkono na FAO waweka wazalishaji na wauzaji nje katikati ya kuboresha mfumo wa afya ya mimea Tunisia
sw.summary: Chini ya mradi wa ASCO unaofadhiliwa na Umoja wa Ulaya, FAO na mamlaka za afya ya mimea za Tunisia zilishauriana na vitengo zaidi ya 30 vya uzalishaji wa kilimo vinavyohudumia mauzo ya nje. Majadiliano yalihusu taarifa za kidijitali za afya ya mimea na udhibiti jumuishi wa wadudu ili kupunguza hatari za kutokidhi viwango vya soko la nje.

records.title: FAO and Egypt’s remote-sensing authority explore climate-resilience collaboration
records.summary: FAO’s Near East and North Africa regional office met Egypt’s National Authority for Remote Sensing and Space Sciences to discuss cooperation on landscape restoration, sustainable land management, land-use monitoring and geospatial tools for early warning of drought and land degradation.
records.source: FAO Regional Office for the Near East and North Africa

fr.title: La FAO et le centre égyptien de télédétection explorent une coopération pour renforcer la résilience climatique
fr.summary: La FAO et l’Autorité nationale égyptienne de télédétection et des sciences spatiales ont examiné une coopération sur les données géospatiales, la télédétection et les systèmes d’information pour soutenir la résilience climatique, la gestion durable des ressources naturelles et la planification agricole.

ar.title: الفاو وهيئة الاستشعار عن بُعد المصرية تبحثان التعاون لتعزيز القدرة على التكيف مع المناخ
ar.summary: بحثت الفاو والهيئة القومية المصرية للاستشعار عن بعد وعلوم الفضاء التعاون في البيانات الجغرافية والاستشعار عن بعد ونظم المعلومات لدعم القدرة على التكيف مع المناخ والإدارة المستدامة للموارد الطبيعية والتخطيط الزراعي.

pt.title: FAO e o centro egípcio de deteção remota exploram cooperação para reforçar a resiliência climática
pt.summary: A FAO e a Autoridade Nacional Egípcia de Deteção Remota e Ciências Espaciais analisaram a cooperação em dados geoespaciais, deteção remota e sistemas de informação para apoiar a resiliência climática, a gestão sustentável dos recursos naturais e o planeamento agrícola.

sw.title: FAO na mamlaka ya Misri ya utambuzi wa mbali zachunguza ushirikiano wa kuimarisha ustahimilivu wa tabianchi
sw.summary: FAO na Mamlaka ya Kitaifa ya Misri ya Utambuzi wa Mbali na Sayansi za Anga zilijadili ushirikiano katika data za kijiografia, utambuzi wa mbali na mifumo ya taarifa ili kusaidia ustahimilivu wa tabianchi, usimamizi endelevu wa rasilimali asilia na mipango ya kilimo.

records.title: Algeria and Norway explore cooperation in fisheries and aquaculture
records.summary: Algeria’s agriculture, rural development and fisheries minister met Norway’s fisheries and ocean-policy minister to discuss sustainable fisheries, modernizing facilities, seafood processing, investment and technical cooperation in aquaculture.
records.source: Algerian Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

fr.title: L’Algérie et la Norvège explorent une coopération dans la pêche et l’aquaculture
fr.summary: Le ministre algérien de l’Agriculture, du Développement rural et de la Pêche a rencontré la ministre norvégienne chargée de la pêche et de la politique océanique pour discuter de la pêche durable, de la modernisation des installations, de la transformation des produits de la mer, des investissements et de la coopération technique en aquaculture.

ar.title: الجزائر والنرويج تبحثان التعاون في مصايد الأسماك والاستزراع المائي
ar.summary: اجتمع وزير الزراعة والتنمية الريفية والصيد البحري الجزائري مع الوزيرة النرويجية المعنية بمصايد الأسماك وسياسات المحيطات لمناقشة الصيد المستدام وتحديث المرافق وتصنيع المأكولات البحرية والاستثمار والتعاون الفني في الاستزراع المائي.

pt.title: Argélia e Noruega exploram cooperação nas pescas e na aquicultura
pt.summary: O ministro argelino da Agricultura, Desenvolvimento Rural e Pescas reuniu-se com a ministra norueguesa responsável pelas pescas e pela política oceânica para discutir pescas sustentáveis, modernização de instalações, transformação de produtos do mar, investimento e cooperação técnica em aquicultura.

sw.title: Algeria na Norway zachunguza ushirikiano katika uvuvi na ufugaji wa viumbe vya majini
sw.summary: Waziri wa Kilimo, Maendeleo ya Vijijini na Uvuvi wa Algeria alikutana na waziri wa Norway anayeshughulikia uvuvi na sera za bahari kujadili uvuvi endelevu, kuboresha vifaa, usindikaji wa mazao ya baharini, uwekezaji na ushirikiano wa kiufundi katika ufugaji wa viumbe vya majini.

records.title: Egypt and Spain discuss agricultural trade and investment
records.summary: Egypt’s agriculture minister met Spain’s agriculture minister to discuss agricultural trade, cooperative development, farmer insurance, quarantine procedures, greenhouse farming, irrigation efficiency and investment opportunities.

fr.title: L’Égypte et l’Espagne discutent du commerce agricole et des investissements
fr.summary: Le ministre égyptien de l’Agriculture a rencontré son homologue espagnol pour discuter du commerce agricole, de la coopération, de l’assurance des agriculteurs, des procédures de quarantaine, des serres, de l’efficacité de l’irrigation et des possibilités d’investissement.

ar.title: مصر وإسبانيا تبحثان التجارة الزراعية والاستثمار
ar.summary: اجتمع وزير الزراعة المصري مع نظيره الإسباني لمناقشة التجارة الزراعية والتعاون والتأمين على المزارعين وإجراءات الحجر الزراعي والزراعة في البيوت المحمية وكفاءة الري وفرص الاستثمار.

pt.title: Egito e Espanha discutem comércio agrícola e investimento
pt.summary: O ministro da Agricultura do Egito reuniu-se com o seu homólogo espanhol para discutir o comércio agrícola, a cooperação, o seguro dos agricultores, os procedimentos de quarentena, a produção em estufas, a eficiência da irrigação e oportunidades de investimento.

sw.title: Misri na Hispania zajadili biashara ya kilimo na uwekezaji
sw.summary: Waziri wa Kilimo wa Misri alikutana na mwenzake wa Hispania kujadili biashara ya kilimo, ushirikiano, bima ya wakulima, taratibu za karantini, kilimo cha greenhouses, ufanisi wa umwagiliaji na fursa za uwekezaji.

records.title: Mauritania prepares national vegetable-growing campaign
records.summary: The prime minister chaired an interministerial meeting on the upcoming vegetable campaign, discussing support for local production, agricultural inputs, fertilizer tax exemptions, marketing, storage, water and electricity access.
records.source: National Drilling and Wells Company, Mauritania

fr.title: La Mauritanie prépare une campagne nationale de soutien à la production maraîchère
fr.summary: La Société nationale de forage et de puits décrit une campagne de soutien à la production de légumes destinée aux communautés proches de ses sites, dans le cadre des actions de développement local et de renforcement des moyens de subsistance.

ar.title: موريتانيا تستعد لحملة وطنية لدعم إنتاج الخضروات
ar.summary: تصف الشركة الوطنية للحفر والآبار حملة لدعم إنتاج الخضروات لصالح المجتمعات القريبة من مواقعها، ضمن جهود التنمية المحلية وتعزيز سبل العيش.

pt.title: Mauritânia prepara uma campanha nacional de apoio à produção hortícola
pt.summary: A Empresa Nacional de Perfuração e Poços descreve uma campanha de apoio à produção de hortícolas para as comunidades próximas das suas instalações, como parte das ações de desenvolvimento local e reforço dos meios de subsistência.

sw.title: Mauritania yaandaa kampeni ya kitaifa ya kusaidia uzalishaji wa mboga
sw.summary: Kampuni ya Kitaifa ya Uchimbaji na Visima inaeleza kampeni ya kusaidia uzalishaji wa mboga kwa jamii zilizo karibu na maeneo yake, kama sehemu ya juhudi za maendeleo ya eneo na kuimarisha maisha.

records.title: Early autumn rains raise hopes for Morocco’s new farming season
records.summary: Moroccan farmers are preparing soil, seeds, fertilizers and irrigation infrastructure for the new planting season, while producers in rain-dependent and irrigated regions await more sustained rainfall.

fr.title: Les premières pluies d’automne ravivent l’espoir pour la nouvelle saison agricole au Maroc
fr.summary: Les agriculteurs marocains préparent les sols, les semences, les engrais et les systèmes d’irrigation pour la nouvelle campagne, tandis que les producteurs des régions pluviales et irriguées attendent des précipitations plus régulières.

ar.title: أمطار الخريف المبكرة تجدد الآمال بالموسم الزراعي الجديد في المغرب
ar.summary: يستعد المزارعون في المغرب بتجهيز التربة والبذور والأسمدة وشبكات الري للموسم الجديد، فيما ينتظر المنتجون في المناطق البعلية والمروية هطول أمطار أكثر انتظاماً.

pt.title: As primeiras chuvas de outono renovam a esperança para a nova época agrícola em Marrocos
pt.summary: Os agricultores marroquinos estão a preparar os solos, sementes, fertilizantes e infraestruturas de irrigação para a nova campanha, enquanto os produtores de regiões de sequeiro e irrigadas aguardam chuvas mais regulares.

sw.title: Mvua za mwanzo za vuli zafufua matumaini ya msimu mpya wa kilimo nchini Morocco
sw.summary: Wakulima wa Morocco wanaandaa udongo, mbegu, mbolea na miundombinu ya umwagiliaji kwa msimu mpya, huku wazalishaji katika maeneo ya mvua na umwagiliaji wakisubiri mvua endelevu zaidi.

records.title: Heatwaves damage Tunisia’s autumn tomato production prospects
records.summary: The Tunisian farmers’ union reported that high temperatures during flowering reduced tomato flower retention and fruit development, affecting autumn harvest prospects in key production areas.

fr.title: Les vagues de chaleur estivales affectent les perspectives de production de tomates d’automne en Tunisie
fr.summary: L’Union tunisienne de l’agriculture et de la pêche rapporte que les températures élevées pendant la floraison ont réduit la rétention des fleurs et le développement des fruits, affectant les perspectives de récolte d’automne dans les principales zones de production.

ar.title: موجات الحر الصيفية تضر بتوقعات إنتاج الطماطم الخريفية في تونس
ar.summary: أفاد الاتحاد التونسي للفلاحة والصيد البحري بأن ارتفاع درجات الحرارة أثناء الإزهار قلل من بقاء الأزهار ونمو الثمار، مما أثر في توقعات حصاد الخريف في مناطق الإنتاج الرئيسية.

pt.title: As ondas de calor do verão afetam as perspetivas da produção de tomate de outono na Tunísia
pt.summary: A União Tunisina da Agricultura e da Pesca informou que as temperaturas elevadas durante a floração reduziram a retenção das flores e o desenvolvimento dos frutos, afetando as perspetivas da colheita de outono nas principais zonas produtoras.

sw.title: Mawimbi ya joto la kiangazi yaathiri matarajio ya uzalishaji wa nyanya za vuli nchini Tunisia
sw.summary: Umoja wa Kilimo na Uvuvi wa Tunisia uliripoti kuwa joto kali wakati wa maua lilipunguza maua kubaki na ukuaji wa matunda, na kuathiri matarajio ya mavuno ya vuli katika maeneo makuu ya uzalishaji.

records.title: Tunisia reviews the 2026 cereal harvest and prepares the next sowing campaign
records.summary: Tunisia’s cereals office scheduled a national conference to review the 2025–2026 cereal collection campaign and coordinate logistics for the 2026–2027 sowing season.

fr.title: La Tunisie examine la récolte céréalière 2026 et prépare la prochaine campagne de semis
fr.summary: L’Office tunisien des céréales a prévu une conférence nationale pour examiner la campagne de collecte céréalière 2025–2026 et coordonner la logistique de la campagne de semis 2026–2027.

ar.title: تونس تراجع حصاد الحبوب لعام 2026 وتستعد لموسم الزراعة المقبل
ar.summary: حدد ديوان الحبوب التونسي مؤتمراً وطنياً لمراجعة حملة جمع الحبوب 2025–2026 وتنسيق الجوانب اللوجستية لموسم البذر 2026–2027.

pt.title: Tunísia avalia a colheita cerealífera de 2026 e prepara a próxima campanha de sementeira
pt.summary: O Gabinete dos Cereais da Tunísia agendou uma conferência nacional para avaliar a campanha de recolha de cereais de 2025–2026 e coordenar a logística da campanha de sementeira de 2026–2027.

sw.title: Tunisia yakagua mavuno ya nafaka ya 2026 na kuandaa msimu ujao wa kupanda
sw.summary: Ofisi ya Nafaka ya Tunisia ilipanga mkutano wa kitaifa kutathmini kampeni ya ukusanyaji wa nafaka ya 2025–2026 na kuratibu maandalizi ya msimu wa kupanda wa 2026–2027.

records.title: Gabon places state agriculture company SAEG under temporary administration
records.summary: Following the lapse of legal orders that would have dissolved the Société d’Agriculture et d’Élevage du Gabon, the cabinet confirmed SAEG remains the state’s agricultural vehicle and ordered a temporary administration to protect its assets, audit operations and review strategy.

fr.title: Le Gabon place la société agricole publique SAEG sous administration provisoire
fr.summary: Après l’expiration des décisions juridiques qui auraient dissous la Société d’Agriculture et d’Élevage du Gabon, le Conseil des ministres a confirmé le maintien de SAEG et ordonné une administration provisoire pour protéger ses actifs, auditer ses activités et réexaminer sa stratégie.

ar.title: الغابون تضع شركة الزراعة وتربية الماشية الحكومية SAEG تحت إدارة مؤقتة
ar.summary: بعد انتهاء الأوامر القانونية التي كان من المفترض أن تحل شركة الزراعة وتربية الماشية في الغابون، أكد مجلس الوزراء استمرار الشركة وأمر بإدارة مؤقتة لحماية أصولها ومراجعة عملياتها واستراتيجيتها.

pt.title: Gabão coloca a empresa agrícola estatal SAEG sob administração temporária
pt.summary: Após o término das decisões legais que teriam dissolvido a Société d’Agriculture et d’Élevage du Gabon, o Conselho de Ministros confirmou a continuidade da SAEG e determinou uma administração temporária para proteger os seus ativos, auditar as operações e rever a estratégia.

sw.title: Gabon yaweka kampuni ya kilimo ya serikali SAEG chini ya usimamizi wa muda
sw.summary: Baada ya muda wa amri za kisheria zilizokuwa zingeivunja Société d’Agriculture et d’Élevage du Gabon kuisha, baraza la mawaziri lilithibitisha kuwa SAEG itaendelea na kuagiza usimamizi wa muda ili kulinda mali zake, kukagua shughuli na kupitia mkakati wake.

records.title: Libya opens its international agricultural and livestock development exhibition
records.summary: The Tripoli exhibition brought together agricultural and livestock-sector bodies, local and international companies, and equipment and technology providers, with a focus on development of crop and animal production and protection of agricultural land and pasture.

fr.title: La Libye ouvre son exposition internationale sur le développement agricole et de l’élevage
fr.summary: L’exposition de Tripoli a réuni des organismes des secteurs agricole et de l’élevage, des entreprises locales et internationales ainsi que des fournisseurs d’équipements et de technologies, afin de soutenir le développement des productions végétales et animales et la protection des terres agricoles et des pâturages.

ar.title: ليبيا تفتتح معرضها الدولي للتنمية الزراعية والحيوانية
ar.summary: جمع معرض طرابلس مؤسسات القطاعين الزراعي والحيواني وشركات محلية ودولية وموردي المعدات والتقنيات، مع التركيز على تطوير إنتاج المحاصيل والثروة الحيوانية وحماية الأراضي الزراعية والمراعي.

pt.title: Líbia abre a sua exposição internacional de desenvolvimento agrícola e pecuário
pt.summary: A exposição em Trípoli reuniu entidades dos setores agrícola e pecuário, empresas locais e internacionais e fornecedores de equipamentos e tecnologias, com foco no desenvolvimento da produção vegetal e animal e na proteção das terras agrícolas e pastagens.

sw.title: Libya yafungua maonesho yake ya kimataifa ya maendeleo ya kilimo na mifugo
sw.summary: Maonesho ya Tripoli yaliwakutanisha taasisi za sekta za kilimo na mifugo, kampuni za ndani na za kimataifa pamoja na wasambazaji wa vifaa na teknolojia, yakilenga kuendeleza uzalishaji wa mazao na mifugo na kulinda ardhi ya kilimo na malisho.

records.title: AfDB publishes completion report for Comoros emergency agricultural production support
records.summary: The African Development Bank’s completion report reviews an emergency project designed to strengthen local food production and resilience, including maize, potato and sweet-potato production and support for poultry and vulnerable households.

records.title: Chad restricts grain exports and waives import duties amid food shortages
records.summary: The Chadian government announced emergency measures after heat and drought damaged crops, including a ban on exports of staple grains and customs-duty exemptions for imported grain to help address food shortages.

records.title: Gabon and FAO strengthen farmer capacity with agricultural and fisheries equipment
records.summary: FAO, working with the Government of Gabon, delivered agricultural and fisheries equipment to project beneficiaries in Lébamba following months of training. The initiative supports agricultural modernization, production conditions and food security, with attention to women and young people.

fr.title: La FAO et le Gabon renforcent les capacités des producteurs grâce à des équipements agricoles et halieutiques
fr.summary: La FAO et le gouvernement gabonais ont remis des équipements agricoles et de pêche aux bénéficiaires d’un projet à Lébamba après plusieurs mois de formation. L’initiative soutient la modernisation agricole, l’amélioration des conditions de production et la sécurité alimentaire, avec une attention particulière aux femmes et aux jeunes.

ar.title: الفاو والغابون تعززان قدرات المنتجين بمعدات زراعية وسمكية
ar.summary: قدمت الفاو والحكومة الغابونية معدات زراعية ومعدات للصيد إلى المستفيدين من مشروع في ليبامبا بعد أشهر من التدريب. ويدعم البرنامج تحديث الزراعة وتحسين ظروف الإنتاج والأمن الغذائي، مع اهتمام خاص بالنساء والشباب.

pt.title: FAO e Gabão reforçam as capacidades dos produtores com equipamentos agrícolas e de pesca
pt.summary: A FAO e o governo do Gabão entregaram equipamentos agrícolas e de pesca aos beneficiários de um projeto em Lébamba após vários meses de formação. A iniciativa apoia a modernização agrícola, melhores condições de produção e segurança alimentar, com atenção especial às mulheres e aos jovens.

sw.title: FAO na Gabon zaimarisha uwezo wa wazalishaji kwa vifaa vya kilimo na uvuvi
sw.summary: FAO na serikali ya Gabon zilikabidhi vifaa vya kilimo na uvuvi kwa wanufaika wa mradi mjini Lébamba baada ya miezi kadhaa ya mafunzo. Mpango unaunga mkono kisasaishaji cha kilimo, kuboresha mazingira ya uzalishaji na usalama wa chakula, hasa kwa wanawake na vijana.

records.title: Niger produces its first potato seed crop with FAO support
records.summary: FAO reports that Niger harvested 18.8 tonnes of certified G3 potato seed from an initial 550 kilograms of mini-tubers, a pilot result intended to build national seed-production capacity and reduce reliance on imports.

fr.title: Le Niger produit sa première récolte de semences de pomme de terre avec l’appui de la FAO
fr.summary: La FAO rapporte que le Niger a récolté 18,8 tonnes de semences certifiées de pomme de terre de génération G3 à partir de 550 kilogrammes initiaux de mini-tubercules. Ce résultat pilote vise à développer la production nationale de semences et à réduire la dépendance aux importations.

ar.title: النيجر تنتج أول محصول من بذور البطاطا بدعم من الفاو
ar.summary: أفادت الفاو بأن النيجر حصدت 18.8 طناً من بذور البطاطا المعتمدة من الجيل الثالث G3 انطلاقاً من 550 كيلوغراماً من الدرنات الصغيرة. وتهدف هذه التجربة إلى بناء القدرة الوطنية على إنتاج البذور وتقليل الاعتماد على الواردات.

pt.title: Níger produz a sua primeira colheita de sementes de batata com apoio da FAO
pt.summary: A FAO informa que o Níger colheu 18,8 toneladas de sementes certificadas de batata da geração G3 a partir de 550 quilogramas iniciais de minitubérculos. O resultado-piloto pretende desenvolver a produção nacional de sementes e reduzir a dependência das importações.

sw.title: Niger yazalisha zao lake la kwanza la mbegu za viazi kwa msaada wa FAO
sw.summary: FAO inaripoti kuwa Niger ilivuna tani 18.8 za mbegu za viazi zilizoidhinishwa za kizazi cha G3 kutoka kilo 550 za awali za viazi vidogo. Matokeo haya ya majaribio yanalenga kujenga uwezo wa kitaifa wa uzalishaji wa mbegu na kupunguza utegemezi wa uagizaji.

records.title: FAO GIEWS country brief: Libya’s 2026 cereal outlook and food inflation
records.summary: FAO’s country brief reviews mixed weather effects on Libya’s 2026 wheat and barley prospects, above-average cereal import requirements for 2026/27, and rising food inflation. It is a country-situation reference rather than a breaking-news article.
records.review_reason: Official country situation brief, not a conventional news article. Editorial review required to confirm placement and multilingual presentation.

records.title: Niger ministry reports on the 2026 agropastoral campaign monitoring mission
records.summary: The ministry’s October bulletin describes inspections of irrigation infrastructure, tomato production development, livestock services, feed-storage works and regional agricultural support during the 2026 campaign.
records.source: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock, Niger

records.title: Niger ministry reports inspections of licensed private veterinary establishments
records.summary: An October ministry bulletin describes a regional inspection mission checking veterinary-practice authorizations, medicine approval, storage conditions and cold-chain compliance in Zinder.
records.source: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock, Niger

records.title: Equatorial Guinea advances plans for an agro-food laboratory
records.summary: The government press service reports that the prime minister is advancing implementation of an agro-food laboratory intended to support food quality and agricultural development.
records.source: Guinea Ecuatorial Press, Government of Equatorial Guinea

records.title: Grande Foire Agricole du Congo 2026 prepares agricultural exhibitions and sector meetings
records.summary: The official fair website advertises agricultural exhibitions, producer and investor meetings, machinery and input displays, training and agribusiness networking ahead of the 2026 event.
records.source: Grande Foire Agricole du Congo, official event site
